scope_caveats: The recorded tool trace corroborates provenance; it is not tamper-proof attestation or an OS sandbox.
One Read opened provider-persisted output of an authorized reference-document read outside the literal disposable workspace; no auth-file read appears in the trace.
The agent used a local shell source repair and compiler invocation in addition to Write/Edit tools; game source is retained byte-for-byte.

The original compiler output reports success with zero warnings/errors but its shell pipeline did not preserve a separate compiler exit code. Native loading and independent gameplay verify the resulting DLL.

limits: Two different small agent-built game exercises are now recorded across Codex and Claude; this is not a broad success-rate benchmark or a comparison against another engine.
Defense uses primitive geometry, instantaneous hitscan and prescribed straight-line kinematic lanes, with logical HUD and synthetic controller inputs.
Rendered defense presentation, physical inputs, navigation, Native AOT, Linux and console execution of this fixture remain unqualified.
Pause is a playback intent; a headless owner that keeps stepping still advances physics.
The terminal branch after surviving waves with fewer than nine kills, despite remaining reactor health, is not exercised here.
Elapsed replay time measures this standalone test run only; it is not agent game-creation time, frame rate or a general engine benchmark.
The authoring API remains a candidate; runtime/gameplay/save formats are not frozen. The installed desktop package remains unchanged.
Raw provider/RPC logs and machine-local paths are excluded from the repository.
